current.text: He averaged 16 points, 8 rebounds, 6 assists and 2 threes in Summer League, but shot 26% from three.
He is not expected to start for Boston.
He could get a solid role if Payton Pritchard comes off the bench. Two Boston previews project Pritchard as a bench player.
He could have a double-digit scoring season if Derrick White bounces back.
Boston has at least 12 rotation-level players. The newest preview's 10-man rotation does not include him, so he has to compete for minutes.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Deep Boston roster with at least 12 rotation-level players. Not in the projected 10-man rotation.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Could reach double-digit scoring if Pritchard comes off the bench or Derrick White bounces back.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD, with ranks of 345 on Yahoo and 249 on ESPN. That is far outside the 144 players we draft, so do not spend a pick on him. His projected line of about 5.7 points, 0.9 assists and 0.8 threes has no strong category, and his low turnovers come from his small role. Watch him on waivers early. The things to check are whether he gets into Boston's 10-man rotation and gets close to ESPN's projected 21.7 minutes, mainly if Pritchard stays on the bench or White struggles.
